gates.evidence: Proposal surface is s01 (Daily Checkin Dialog) with game partner 'The Midnight Library', which is SFW and age-appropriate.
Proposal rewards in-app credits (r1) for completing a rewarded mini-game; no clicks or installs are incentivized.
Proposal uses gain framing ('Earn Bonus Credits') with a clear decline option ('No thanks') and no dark patterns.
Proposal features an explicit CTA button 'Play Now' on the offer card.
Proposal clearly states the exact reward (+10 credits) and required action (15-second game) prior to the ad.
Proposal includes an equally legible decline option ('No thanks') that leaves the user on s01 with no penalty.
Trigger is set immediately after claiming the daily check-in reward on s01, entirely separate from chat streaming.
Eligibility is explicitly restricted to non-paying guests who have completed their daily check-in.

scores.evidence: Triggers precisely at moment m4 (post-reward on Daily Checkin Dialog s01), offering bonus credits right when the user is engaged with check-in rewards.
Feels completely native as an extension of the daily check-in flow, taking nothing away and preserving the user state.
Restricted to non-paying guests, capped at 1 per day, with a reward value (+10 credits / $0.0139) far below the cheapest pack ($1.39).
Cost to serve ($0.0018) is well below net revenue per view, and reward value aligns closely with single-view ad revenue.
Leverages the daily check-in touchpoint, which is a frequent and habitual engagement loop for users.
Uses Simula SIM-RWD unit with button entry, REWARD_VERIFIED grant, and standard server-side verification.
Directly uses the app's nouns and IDs: r1 credits, src1 daily check-in, s01 Daily Checkin Dialog, and game partner 'The Midnight Library'.
Caps the offer strictly at 1 per day with a 1440-minute cooldown and clear decline path.
Defines rewarded ARPDAU as primary metric, lists key guardrails, and specifies a 5% user-level randomized holdout for 28 days.

parsed.topConcern: None. The proposal is exceptionally well-scoped, economically sound, and strictly adheres to all policy and product guidelines.
